Run recruitment at a real club on the last day of the window, haggle with selling clubs, agree personal terms with agents and fill the board's needs before the window shuts. Deadline Day puts you in charge of recruitment at a real club on the last day of the summer transfer window. The board have picked out three or four places in the side that need an upgrade, left you a budget, and the window shuts at 11pm. It runs on the Club Manager transfer desk, so every asking price, counter, patience count, valuation read, rival bid and agent's demand is the same one the full game plays. What is new is the clock: twelve hours, and every bid costs one of them. There is a daily, the same club, the same list and the same budget for everyone, and a free play mode at any club you like. How to play Deadline Day, the free transfer window game Choosing the daily club or free play Open today's window for the shared daily club, or pick any club in free play, or let the game pick one at random. Reading the board's brief Read the brief. Each need is a place in your current eleven, with who starts there now and the rating that would count as an upgrade.
